scope.implemented: Source-authenticated initial preflight, frozen joint solve plan, complete per-branch context vector/far-pair proofs, normalized residuals, one SciPy TRF attempt per initialized branch, callback/external budgets, complete/partial/abort traces, independent raw-rounded/global-L readback and objective/movement/index selection
scope.not_implemented: Tracked-source 30-cell three-arm comparison runner, delayed native scoring, full cohort qualification, public materialization/H-parent integration
scope.numerical_inputs: Plan with original problem, declared starts and masked metadata ONLY; no complete prepared bytes, reference/witness/candidate/seed input
scope.source_authentication_and_physical_accep: Independent external audit reopens original/prepared bytes; numeric return/solver success alone cannot approve geometry

frozen_controls.method: trf; jac=2-point; tr_solver=exact; x_scale=1; diff_step=1e-6; linear loss; ftol/xtol/gtol=1e-10; max_nfev=600
frozen_controls.budget_breach_accounting: The 50,001st callback is counted as a blocked breach, NOT evaluated; initial/final external residual calls are counted separately
frozen_controls.movement: 3*n local displacements bounded +/-8/sqrt(3) A; both raw and rounded per-atom Euclidean cap 8 A; observations never move
frozen_controls.context: All eligible generated/generated pairs plus generated/observed pairs not proven farther than 8+0.7 A from own start; only authoritative 1-2/1-3 exclusions; fixed pair vector in canonical identity order
frozen_controls.far_proof: Count/minimum distance plus SHA256 stream of canonical-row SHA256 values in canonical pair order; recomputed from retained full problem/start, never a source crop
frozen_controls.budget_admission: Oversized numerical vector refuses without usable truncated pairs; inherited total metadata-topology cap and existing JSON byte/node/depth limits checked before numerical dispatch
frozen_controls.constraints: All R0 graph metrics including fixed-only constants, every source/extra interval/plane/stereo/exclusion and eligible severe-separation pair; no regularizer, reference objective, reflection, fallback, restarts or omitted upper exclusion bound
frozen_controls.source_of_refusals: Existing Constraint DTO already refuses nonzero plane lower bounds; its rule was not weakened just to exercise a redundant numerical guard

trace_and_selection.retained: Every branch reason/status/start-plan binding, solver status/message/nfev/njev, returned displacement vector, complete raw/rounded additions, initial/final residuals, counters and last finite PARTIAL evaluation
trace_and_selection.unexpected_errors: Abort via CycleExecutionAborted with a prefix result and current finite diagnostics; optional exclusive on_branch sink can retain completed branches durably. Never fabricate unrun attempts or a chemical rejection.
trace_and_selection.missing_dependencies: Declared missing SciPy/NumPy is unavailable with no optimizer dispatch; unrelated dependency/programming errors abort visibly
trace_and_selection.independent_readback: Rebinds source/plan/initial audits/pair proofs/runtime/coordinate transport/objectives/counter consistency, measures both phases through independent R1B physical owner, then derives selection; no initializer/linear solve/materializer/optimizer calls
trace_and_selection.counter_evidence_limit: Counters are observed execution metadata, not proof of a particular optimizer trajectory; trusted code/artifact hashes bind them. Physical acceptance does not rely on counters/objective alone.
trace_and_selection.selection: Only complete solver-success AND independently raw/rounded/global-L/rounding/movement-passing branches; key is final raw squared residual, raw maximum movement, branch index; all eight attempted, no first-success stop or native rerank
trace_and_selection.selected_status: selected-declared-geometry-only; not H-parent, source coverage, native/MD or public qualification
trace_and_selection.codec: Only three new standalone roots/imports; normalized source byte-identical to d368553; no old Strategy/VARIANTS/parser bound or decoding change
